Deprecated names of baystability 0.2.0

Source: R/deprecated.R
bys-deprecated.Rd

These functions of baystability 0.2.0 still work in 1.0.0, with a warning, and will be removed in a later version. Use the new names, which follow those of the package stability and its Bayesian version bayesstability:

old namenew name
ge_mean()bys_ls_means()
ge_var()bys_ls_var()
g_eff()bys_ls_gen_effects()
e_eff()bys_ls_env_effects()
ge_eff()bys_ls_ge_effects()
ge_model()bys_ls_model()
ge_ammi()bys_ls_ammi()
matrix_k()bys_contrasts()
orthnorm()bys_orthonormal()

The arguments and results are unchanged.

Usage

ge_mean(.data, .y, .gen, .env)

# Default S3 method
ge_mean(.data, .y, .gen, .env)

ge_var(.data, .y, .gen, .env)

# Default S3 method
ge_var(.data, .y, .gen, .env)

g_eff(.data, .y, .gen, .env)

# Default S3 method
g_eff(.data, .y, .gen, .env)

e_eff(.data, .y, .gen, .env)

# Default S3 method
e_eff(.data, .y, .gen, .env)

ge_eff(.data, .y, .gen, .env)

# Default S3 method
ge_eff(.data, .y, .gen, .env)

ge_model(.data, .y, .gen, .env, .rep)

# Default S3 method
ge_model(.data, .y, .gen, .env, .rep)

ge_ammi(.data, .y, .gen, .env, .rep)

# Default S3 method
ge_ammi(.data, .y, .gen, .env, .rep)

matrix_k(n)

# Default S3 method
matrix_k(n)

orthnorm(u = NULL, basis = TRUE, norm = TRUE)

# Default S3 method
orthnorm(u = NULL, basis = TRUE, norm = TRUE)

Arguments

.data, .y, .gen, .env, .rep, n, u, basis, norm

the arguments of the earlier version, passed on to the new function.

Value

The result of the new function.
